liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Black Peter** (1 review): Listener highlights the performance of this specific track as very nice [4]
- **Good Morning Little Schoolgirl** (1 review): Stephen Stills contributes sweetly to this track and Morning Dew [14]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Jerry and Stills perform the song in an unorthodox jug band style [6]

## Setlist highlights

- **Black Queen**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [16]

## The recordings

- **gd69-12-10.sbd.gerland.10986.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 17 songs; 118 min; rated 3.86/5 by 7 [1]
- **gd69-12-10.sbd-aud.cotsman.8997.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 17 songs; 117 min; rated 3.43/5 by 7 [2]. Said about its sound: Recording features mellow yet driving energy with clean, spacious jamming groove [7]
- **gd1969-12-10.sbd.barbella.8214.sbeok.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 12 songs; 90 min; rated 3.86/5 by 7 [3]

## Around the show

- Stephen Stills appears, delivering aggressive, sometimes intrusive, and long-winded contributions [5]
- Reviewer notes the band sounded great with Stills, regretting limited playing time [8]
- Band road-tests material for Workingman's Dead shortly after Live/Dead release [10]
- Stephen Stills joins for Black Queen, contributing to the show's quality [11]
- Reviewer argues this date is superior to the following day's performance [4]
- Black Queen performance resembles a later 1983 show where Stills also appeared [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-12-10.sbd.gerland.10986.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Dave Greenberg, Jack Warner, Scott Clugston, Jim Powell, Jay Gerland; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Tapes exist in two parts, one from MSR to D, both excellent quality [1]
- **gd69-12-10.sbd-aud.cotsman.8997.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Andrew Clarke, Jack Warner and JCotsman; source: Set 1: Soundboard, Set 2: Audience [2]
- **gd1969-12-10.sbd.barbella.8214.sbeok.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by EAC>SHN Transfer by Steve Barbella; source: Master Soundboard Reel > DAT > CDR [3]. Also: Recording presumed to be set one, possibly complete, with missing pre-song [3]
